abstract: Essentially, debt financing aims to enhance corporate performance through effective debt management, underscoring the trade-offs between associated costs and benefits. Using data from Chinese listed firms during 2010–2022, this study defines debt utilization efficiency using a DuPont analysis and demonstrates that in corporate settings, it is significantly improved by environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance. This conclusion remains unchanged after a battery of robustness tests. Mediation analysis shows that attention from external analysts partially mediates the relationship between ESG performance and debt utilization efficiency. We further find that intense industry competition positively moderates the relationship between ESG performance and debt utilization efficiency, while high environmental uncertainty negatively moderates this relationship. Our study thus expands the literature on debt financing and highlights the role of ESG in financial sustainability.
abstract_zh: 债务融资的本质在于通过有效的债务管理提升企业绩效，这凸显了相关成本与收益之间的权衡关系。本研究基于2010-2022年中国上市公司数据，运用杜邦分析法界定债务利用效率，并证明在企业情境下，环境、社会与治理（ESG）表现能显著提升该效率。经过一系列稳健性检验后，该结论依然成立。中介效应分析表明，外部分析师关注度在ESG表现与债务利用效率之间起部分中介作用。进一步研究发现，行业竞争强度正向调节ESG表现与债务利用效率的关系，而环境不确定性则负向调节该关系。本研究拓展了债务融资领域的文献，并凸显了ESG在财务可持续性中的重要作用。

title: The trade-off between costs and benefits: ESG performance and debt utilization efficiency
title_zh: 成本与收益的权衡：ESG表现与债务利用效率
